title: Garona
wikitext:
Garona was a half [[Orc]], half [[Human]] assassin that served as personal assistant to [[Gul'dan]] just before and during the [[First War]].  Prior to the [[Horde]]'s final attack on [[Stormwind]] Keep she personally assassinated King Llane of Azeroth.
